text:
Celeste (PM): quick sync  we need a decision on regional priority lanes for Dedicated: customers want guaranteed regional capacity + controlled preemption tiers.
Arjun (Infra): proposal: add per-region priority lanes (gold/silver/bronze) that map to admission priority + preemption order. defaults: tenants get bronze in their primary region.
Maggie (SRE): ops constraints: preemption must emit an eviction_grace window and a drain signal to running sessions. Prefer soft-preempt (notify + 30s drain) for silver, hard immediate for bronze when region saturated.
Omid (Sales): customers will pay for gold lanes. need clear SLA doc and sample invoice lines. also want the option to pin traffic to a region even if cheaper capacity elsewhere exists.
Kai (Billing): billing needs fields lane_id, lane_charge_code, preempted_tokens, region_pin. also report preemption events per tenant for refunds/credits.
Arjun (Infra): API sketch:
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/region_config
{
  "primary_region": "eu-west-1",
  "lane": "bronze",          # bronze | silver | gold
  "pin_to_region": false,
  "preempt_behavior": "soft" # soft | hard
}
Maggie (SRE): runtime: admission uses lane priority and remaining_reserved to order queue; preempt decisions run every 10s with hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. emit event with preempt_reason and grace_seconds.
Celeste (PM): default choices? Recommend default lane=bronze, pin_to_region=false, preempt_behavior=soft for silver/gold only. Gold gets longer grace (60s) and lower preempt probability.
Omid (Sales): customers buying gold should get a dashboard badge and explicit contract clause about grace_seconds and regional pin costs.
Kai (Billing): refund rule: if preemption causes >10% of a contracted event to be dropped, auto-credit pro-rated burst fees. need exportable credit_reason.
Arjun (Infra): implementation notes: store lane as small enum on tenant ledger; preemption pass consults lane weight and regional utilization. need efficient skyline query per region to pick eviction candidates.
Maggie (SRE): acceptance tests: regional saturation scenario, cross-region failover honoring pin_to_region, and preemption grace timing tests. add alert if preempt_rate > 0.5% over 1h.
Celeste (PM): decisions: MVP = lane enums + default bronze, pin opt-in, soft preempt for silver/gold, billing fields and dashboard exposure. Omid/Kai to prepare comms and contract snippets. Arjun/Maggie to break into tickets.
ops-bot: created RFC DCR-6123: "regional-priority-lanes + preempt-grace MVP" and linked to roadmap board.
Celeste (PM): thanks team  we'll reconvene after sprint planning to set dates. :rocket:
